text:
maya - marketing lead: Heads-up: we need the Saffron customer story lined up. Interview, legal release, gated brief + webinar CTA by next Wed.
sam - producer: I booked Diego for Mon 10am PT. Plan: 20m interview + 10m quote drafting. Ian record and transcribe.
diego (customer): Confirmed. I can surface topline numbers beforehand: ~3x throughput, ~42% per-token cost reduction, and improved 99th pct latency. Will share verification after the call.
jin - product marketer: We also want a before/after chart for the blog. Please get baselines.
sam - producer: Deliverables: audio + transcript Tue EOD, two quote variants Wed AM, 500-word case brief draft after legal OK.
lex - legal: Send a short release form. If we publish the 42% stat, Diego does need to sign off in writing. Otherwise we should use "about 40%".
tara - design: Ian reserve the hero asset; need final quote + logo usage by Thu to finalize layouts.
owen - sales: For anyone who downloads the gated brief, route to AE queue and include webinar invite. Need SFDC campaign name to wire automation.
maya - marketing lead: I'll create the campaign and set the nurture. @comms-bot add follow-up to assign leads to Owen's queue when form is live.
comms-bot: Action created: "Saffron gated brief - route leads to owen.sales"  due 2026-04-07
sam - producer: Draft quote for quick legal eyes: "Redwood Inference reduced Saffron's per-token cost by 42% while improving 99th percentile latency, enabling near real-time responses." Thoughts?
lex - legal: I'll review. Avoid implying guarantees; require written approval for exact numbers.
diego (customer): I can sign off on that wording and will attach an internal slide post-interview.
jin - product marketer: Once legal clears, I'll write two headline options (benchmark-led and customer-outcome-led).
maya - marketing lead: Also want Diego as a webinar guest. Can we tentatively schedule Wed two weeks out at 9:30am PT?
diego (customer): That works. Morning PT preferred.
sam - producer: I'll draft a 2-slide SDR playbook from the interview for outbound follow-up.
tara - design: Placeholder banner set; final assets due Thu before publish.
lex - legal: Expect redlines within 24h of receiving quote drafts.
maya - marketing lead: Recap actions: Sam run interview Mon 10am PT; Diego provide verification slides; Sam deliver transcript + drafts; Lex clear quotes; Tara finalize assets Thu; Maya create SFDC campaign + webinar RSVP; Owen prep AE follow-up. Anything else?
jin - product marketer: Add a 1-page snippet for SDRs with top metrics and one-liners.
sam - producer: Will include it.
comms-bot: Reminder set: "Check legal signoff"  2026-04-08
maya - marketing lead: Thanks team, I'll publish the calendar invite once legal signs off. :rocket:
